sources: Swordmancer set (3 pieces): rmxlinux Json/SkillData passive_equipsuit_physuit_01 (cardAttributeModifier attr 26 poise_up: Stagger Efficiency +20%, in the stat panel; buffs: buff_equipsuit_physuit_01). BuffData buff_equipsuit_physuit_01: on abilityEvent 102 with CheckBuffIdInContext tag −6380412 (a physical status: buff_dung_physicalstatus_enemy lists it beside Vulnerable's 1075718177, buff_gambling_take_physical_abnormal checks it for "physical abnormal"), CheckGlobalCDTimerAction, then DamageAction `atk_scale` (2.5) damageType 0 (Physical), skill mask 0 (no skill-type bonus), with `poise` 10, and AddGlobalCDTimer `duration` (15 s, per wearer). Description: "After the wearer applies a Physical Status, the wearer also performs 1 hit that deals {atk_scale} ATK of Physical DMG and [{poise} Stagger]. Effect trigger cooldown: {duration}s".

A Vulnerable-only application emits a vulnerable event, not physicalStatus, so it doesn't proc. Whether Shatter procs, and the hit's scale, are unverified: fixtures/pending/zmdlogs-d9e59d0fb737.json logs the hit (7907 at 11727 ms, with Gilberta's combo Lift) but that battle is in a pre-1.6 anomaly window (implied scale 3.38). In-game test 39.
